categories.title: Materials
categories.intro: Ores, metals, alloys, gems and crafting parts - the foundation of everything you build.

mods.name: Metals
mods.desc: Eight new ores - tin, lead, silver, nickel, zinc, aluminum, platinum and uranium - with raw ores, ingots, nuggets, dusts and storage blocks, plus dusts for vanilla metals.

mods.name: Alloys
mods.desc: Bronze, brass, steel, electrum, invar, constantan and duralumin - the alloys every Frontierworks machine is built from. Mix dusts by hand early on, then use the Alloy Kiln or Alloy Smelter.

mods.name: Parts
mods.desc: Plates, gears, rods and wires for every metal, hand crafting tools, and the machine frames, motors and coils that all Frontierworks machines are assembled from.

mods.name: Gems
mods.desc: Ruby, sapphire, peridot, topaz and onyx: deep ores, gem blocks, and the gems used for jewellery, relics and high-tier tools.

mods.name: Minerals
mods.desc: Sulfur, saltpeter, graphite, fluorite and apatite ores - the raw chemistry behind explosives, fertilizer, batteries and reactor parts.

mods.name: Crystals
mods.desc: Crystal geodes deep underground: Energite powers advanced circuits and batteries, Voidite bends space for teleporters. Budding blocks regrow crystals over time.

mods.name: Oil
mods.desc: Crude oil lakes in deserts, badlands and plains, plus oil sand deposits. Refine crude into diesel, lubricant and plastics, and pave roads with fast-walking asphalt.

mods.name: Circuits
mods.desc: Silicon, wafers and the four circuit tiers - basic, advanced, elite and quantum - plus the Circuit Assembler that builds them efficiently.

categories.title: Machines & Power
categories.intro: Generators, batteries and processing machines. Start with the kiln and a combustion generator, then work up to fusion.

mods.name: Core
mods.desc: Shared framework for every Frontierworks mod: Forge Energy, the machine system, data-driven machine recipes, loot injection and the creative tabs.

mods.name: Kilns
mods.desc: Fuel-fired early-game machines: the Alloy Kiln makes bronze, brass and steel before you have power, and the Coke Oven turns coal into high-energy coal coke.

mods.name: Machines
mods.desc: The first electric machines: Pulverizer (ore doubling), Electric Furnace, Compressor and Extractor. All accept Speed, Efficiency and Capacity upgrades.

mods.name: Alloy Smelter
mods.desc: An electric two-input furnace that fuses metals into alloys, bakes silicon and makes glass products.

mods.name: Sifting
mods.desc: Early-game resource gathering: sift gravel, sand, dirt and soul sand by hand for nuggets, gems and seeds, then automate it with the powered Auto-Sifter.

mods.name: Sawmill
mods.desc: An electric Sawmill that cuts logs into six planks plus sawdust, and planks into sticks. Sawdust becomes paper, particle board and fuel briquettes.

mods.name: Centrifuge
mods.desc: The Centrifuge spins materials apart into their components: slag into metals, dirt into clay and sand, magma cream into slime and blaze powder, and moon dust into helium-3.

mods.name: Ore Washer
mods.desc: Tier-two ore processing: the Ore Washer scrubs ores and raw ores with water for triple yields, leaving slag that a Centrifuge can reclaim.

mods.name: Metal Press
mods.desc: A powered Metal Press that stamps ingots into plates, gears, rods and wires using reusable steel molds.

mods.name: Chemistry
mods.desc: The Chemical Reactor combines solids and fluids: sulfuric acid, vulcanized rubber, gunpowder, fertilizer, plastic and rocket-grade chemicals.

mods.name: Electrolysis
mods.desc: The Electrolyzer splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, brine into chlorine and sodium, and heavy water into deuterium for fusion.

mods.name: Petrochemicals
mods.desc: The Refinery splits crude oil into diesel and lubricant; the Diesel Generator burns diesel, biodiesel and rocket fuel for serious power.

mods.name: Cryogenics
mods.desc: The Cryo Freezer turns water into ice and lava into obsidian, and makes cryotheum - a super-coolant used by reactors and cooling coils.

mods.name: Recycler
mods.desc: Turn junk into opportunity: the Recycler grinds any item into scrap, and scrap boxes hold random useful loot - from nuggets to circuits to the occasional diamond.

mods.name: Generators
mods.desc: Your first power: the Combustion Generator burns any furnace fuel, the Reinforced Generator burns it hotter, and the Lava Generator drinks lava for steady energy.

mods.name: Steam Power
mods.desc: Steam-age power: Boilers burn fuel to boil water, Steam Engines and the advanced Steam Turbine turn that steam into Forge Energy. Boilers heat up over time and push steam to neighbours.

mods.name: Solar Power
mods.desc: Four tiers of solar panels, from an 8 FE/t starter panel to the 512 FE/t ultimate array. Hybrid and ultimate panels keep producing at night.

mods.name: Wind Power
mods.desc: Wind turbines that love altitude and storms: build them high, give them open air, and they pay you back with free energy.

mods.name: Hydro Power
mods.desc: Water wheels and hydro turbines that turn rivers and waterfalls into energy - flowing water on each side adds power.

mods.name: Geothermal Power
mods.desc: Geothermal generators that draw heat from lava pools and magma - 50% stronger in the Nether.

mods.name: Batteries
mods.desc: Energy cells from 1M to 512M FE that keep their charge when broken, plus portable batteries that power your gadgets and machines.

mods.name: Energy Cables
mods.desc: Four tiers of energy cables - copper, gold, electrum and superconductor - that link generators, batteries and machines into one network with no losses.

mods.name: Wireless Energy
mods.desc: Beam power anywhere: feed a Wireless Transmitter, link a Receiver to it with a Link Card, and energy flows across any distance - even between dimensions.

mods.name: Nuclear Power
mods.desc: A fission reactor: load uranium fuel rods, keep it fed with water, and manage the heat. More rods mean more efficiency - and more risk. Auto-SCRAM can save you from a meltdown.

mods.name: Fusion Power
mods.desc: The end-game power source: ignite a fusion plasma with 2 million FE, then feed it deuterium and helium-3 from the Moon for 10,000 FE/t.

mods.name: Field Projectors
mods.desc: Powered beacons: a Field Projector bathes every player within 16 blocks in your choice of ten effects - speed, haste, regeneration, resistance, night vision and more - for FE.

categories.title: Logistics
categories.intro: Move items, fluids and energy around, store them, and automate farms and mining.

mods.name: Item Pipes
mods.desc: Instant item logistics: extraction pipes pull from inventories and deliver to the nearest inventory on the network. Right-click an extraction pipe with an item to filter it; redstone pauses it.

mods.name: Fluid Ducts
mods.desc: Move water, lava, oil, steam and every other fluid: pump ducts drain adjacent tanks and machines and fill everything else on the network.

mods.name: Tanks
mods.desc: Portable fluid tanks from 16 to 1,024 buckets that keep their contents when broken. Stack them and they drain downwards.

mods.name: Storage
mods.desc: Crates that keep their contents when picked up, and bulk barrels that hold up to 1,024 stacks of a single item and show it on their face.

mods.name: Conveyors
mods.desc: Conveyor belts in three speeds that carry items, mobs and players - and drop items straight into any inventory at the end of the line. Sneak to stand still.

mods.name: Vacuum Hopper
mods.desc: A hopper with ambition: pulls in every item and experience orb within 4 blocks (more with Range Upgrades) and feeds them to the inventory below.

mods.name: Quarry
mods.desc: An automatic Quarry that strips a 9x9 area (up to 41x41 with Range Upgrades) all the way to bedrock, replacing liquids with stone and sending everything to a chest on top.

mods.name: Electric Pump
mods.desc: An electric pump that drains lakes of lava, oil or any fluid below it (water is infinite), and pushes the fluid into tanks and ducts around it.

mods.name: Farm Automation
mods.desc: The Crop Harvester tends a 9x9 field around itself: harvests and replants crops and nether wart, cuts sugar cane, picks melons and pumpkins, and applies fertilizer.

mods.name: Mob Grinder
mods.desc: Automated mob farming: the Mob Grinder strikes mobs above it like a player would (rare drops included), uses the weapon you give it, and banks the XP. Pets, villagers, golems, named mobs and bosses are always safe.

mods.name: Chunk Loaders
mods.desc: Keep your machines running while you explore: chunk loaders keep a 3x3 or 5x5 area of chunks loaded and ticking.

mods.name: Redstone Devices
mods.desc: Automation helpers: Block Breaker, Block Placer, Player Detector and an adjustable Redstone Clock.

mods.name: Teleporters
mods.desc: Powered teleport pads: record one pad on a Coordinate Card, link another to it, then crouch on the pad to jump - across the world or even between dimensions.

categories.title: Tools & Gear
categories.intro: Tools, weapons, armor and gadgets for getting around the frontier.

mods.name: Toolsmith
mods.desc: Full tool sets in thirteen materials, from early bronze to space-age titanium: swords, pickaxes, axes, shovels and hoes.

mods.name: Armory
mods.desc: Armor sets in eleven materials. Wear a full gem or space-metal set for a bonus: strength, water breathing, luck, haste, fire resistance, resistance, speed and more.

mods.name: Hammers
mods.desc: Hammers and excavators that dig a 3x3 area at once, in eight materials. They mine a little slower and last three times longer. Sneak to dig a single block.

mods.name: Power Tools
mods.desc: Electric drills and chainsaws that run on Forge Energy instead of durability. The advanced drill can switch to 3x3 mining. Charge them in any energy cell.

mods.name: Jetpacks
mods.desc: Energy-powered jetpacks in three tiers. Hold jump to fly, sprint for a horizontal boost (reinforced and flux), and press H to toggle hover mode for gentle descents.

mods.name: Grappling Hooks
mods.desc: Grappling hooks for explorers: fire at any surface, keep holding to be reeled in, sneak to let go. Three tiers with longer reach and faster pulls.

mods.name: Backpacks
mods.desc: Leather, iron, steel and explorer backpacks with up to 54 extra slots. Right-click to open; contents travel with the backpack. Backpacks and shulker boxes cannot be nested.

mods.name: Sleeping Bags
mods.desc: Roll out a sleeping bag anywhere to skip the night without moving your spawn point - perfect for long expeditions.

mods.name: Explorer's Compass
mods.desc: The Explorer's Compass finds every Frontierworks structure: sneak-right-click to choose a target (ruins, dungeons, towers, craters...), right-click to locate it.

mods.name: Rope
mods.desc: Climbable rope for cave diving and cliff faces. Right-click a hanging rope with more rope to extend it, or throw down a whole rope coil at once.

mods.name: Flares & Glowsticks
mods.desc: Light the dark: throw flares that light up caves for two minutes, or place glowsticks that glow forever.

mods.name: Ore Scanner
mods.desc: Handheld ore scanners that outline every ore around you through solid rock for 15 seconds and list what they found. Runs on Forge Energy.

mods.name: Hang Gliders
mods.desc: Hang gliders for soaring off cliffs and sky islands: hold one while falling to glide in the direction you look. Sneak to drop.

mods.name: Goggles
mods.desc: Powered goggles: night vision goggles light up caves, and tactical goggles also reveal every creature within 24 blocks through walls.

mods.name: Builder's Wands
mods.desc: Builder's wands that extend a whole surface of matching blocks by one layer in a single click, pulling the blocks from your inventory.

mods.name: Magnets
mods.desc: Item magnets: switch one on and every item and experience orb nearby flies to you. Sneak to pause it.

mods.name: Vein Miner
mods.desc: Sneak while mining an ore with the right tool to mine the whole connected vein (up to 64 blocks). Costs durability and a little hunger per block.

mods.name: Tree Feller
mods.desc: Chop the base of a natural tree with any axe and the whole trunk comes down. Sneak to chop just one log.

mods.name: Right-Click Harvest
mods.desc: Right-click fully grown crops, nether wart and cocoa to harvest and replant them in one go.

mods.name: Explorer HUD
mods.desc: A compact HUD with coordinates, facing, biome, day and time, and block light level. Press F7 to move or hide it.

mods.name: Inventory Sorting
mods.desc: Press R in any chest, crate or your inventory to merge and sort its contents.

mods.name: Arsenal
mods.desc: New weapon types in twelve materials: long-reach spears, backstabbing daggers, warhammers whose charged blows hit everything nearby, and shield-breaking battleaxes.

mods.name: Blasters
mods.desc: Energy weapons that run on Forge Energy: a quick blaster pistol, a hard-hitting rifle, a six-bolt scatter blaster and an explosive plasma cannon. Recharge them in any energy cell.

mods.name: Demolitions
mods.desc: Things that go boom: bouncing dynamite and bundles, mining charges that turn rock into drops, frag, incendiary and smoke grenades, and C4 you can detonate remotely.

categories.title: Adventure
categories.intro: Creatures, bosses, relics, bounties, trials and treasure.

mods.name: Graves
mods.desc: When you die, a grave keeps all of your items safe at the spot. Only you can open it.

mods.name: Experience Bank
mods.desc: Bank your experience so you never lose it to death or lava: deposit and withdraw levels at the XP Bank.

mods.name: Deep Dungeons
mods.desc: A ruined shaft leads down into sprawling dungeons: spawner halls, crypts, libraries, prisons and armories, with spike traps in the corridors and a locked vault in the treasure room. Find a Dungeon Key in the dungeon's chests to open it.

mods.name: Tech Outposts
mods.desc: Abandoned research stations, radio relays and supply depots left behind by earlier engineers. Salvage their machines and decode their data drives for rare technology.

mods.name: Bunkers
mods.desc: Sealed concrete shelters lie buried under the plains, marked only by a hatch and a rusty mast. Inside: bunks, stores, a dead generator and a command room with the bunker's secrets.

mods.name: Lost Temples
mods.desc: Stepped sun pyramids in the deserts, moss-eaten ziggurats in the jungles and frost shrines in the snow. Mind the pressure plates.

mods.name: Camps
mods.desc: Explorer camps with tents, maps and supplies to share, and fenced bandit hideouts guarded by pillagers with a boss chest full of stolen goods.

mods.name: Treasure Hunting
mods.desc: Treasure maps that lead to dungeons, ruins, salvage sites and buried stashes, a treasure detector that beeps its way to unopened chests, and new treasure in vanilla loot.

mods.name: Frontier Kitchen
mods.desc: Tomatoes, corn, onions and chili peppers (seeds drop from grass), plus sixteen hearty frontier meals: burgers, chili con carne, salsa, cornbread, beef jerky, energy bars, MRE rations and more. Seeds can also be spun into seed oil for biodiesel.

mods.name: Alchemy+
mods.desc: Five new status effects - Vitality, Fortitude, Berserk, Purity and Magnetism - and twenty new potions (including Haste, Resistance, Absorption and Luck) brewed from awkward potions in the vanilla brewing stand.

mods.name: Enchantments+
mods.desc: Eleven new enchantments: Lifesteal, Frostbite, Venom, Thunderstrike, Beheading and Wisdom for weapons; Smelting and Long Reach for tools; Swiftstep and Leaping for boots; and the treasure enchantment Soulbound.

mods.name: Relics
mods.desc: Twelve rare trinkets hidden in dungeons, temples, towers and vanilla structures. Keep one anywhere in your inventory for its power: extra hearts, haste, speed, fire immunity, night vision, a second life and more.

mods.name: Heart Containers
mods.desc: Heart Containers permanently add a heart to your maximum health (up to ten extra). Bosses drop them; dungeons and treasure hold heart fragments - four fragments make a container.

mods.name: Coinage
mods.desc: A frontier currency: hostile mobs drop copper and silver coins (bosses drop gold and platinum). Nine of a coin make one of the next. Spend them with wandering traders, swap them for emeralds, or earn more from bounties.

mods.name: Frontier Bestiary
mods.desc: New creatures for the frontier: deer and wild boars in the forests, rust beetles and venomous cave crawlers underground, scrap drones patrolling the plains at night, bog lurkers in swamps, sand mummies in deserts, frost wraiths in the snow and ember imps in the Nether.

mods.name: The Iron Colossus
mods.desc: A boss: a four-block-tall war machine awakened with a Colossus Core. It smashes the ground, flings you skyward and calls scrap drones when damaged. Defeat it for a Heart Container, colossus plating and the ground-shaking Colossus Maul.

mods.name: The Wraith King
mods.desc: A boss of the night: place the Cursed Crown after dark to summon the Wraith King. He hurls wither skulls, blinks behind you and raises skeleton guards - wither skeletons once he's enraged. Drops a Heart Container, soul gems and the life-draining Wraith Blade.

mods.name: The Sky Wyvern
mods.desc: A boss of the high skies: blow a Wyvern Lure above y=140 (or anywhere in the Skylands) and the Sky Wyvern answers - a winged beast that rains fireballs and dives at you. Its scales make fireproof armor that lets you drift down gently while sneaking.

mods.name: Bounty Board
mods.desc: Craft a bounty board and right-click it for a hunting contract: slay a number of a given monster (vanilla or Frontierworks), then hand the finished contract back for coins and a loot roll. Harder targets pay more.

mods.name: Trial Grounds
mods.desc: Place a Trial Altar, feed it a Trial Sigil and fight off waves of monsters that spawn around it. Clear every wave for a treasure hoard; a Greater Sigil brings five tougher waves and better loot. Leave and the trial fails.

categories.title: Exploration
categories.intro: Structures to discover, new plants and caves, and gates to other dimensions.

mods.name: Rubber
mods.desc: Rubber trees grow in jungles, forests and swamps. Tap their logs with a Treetap (or use an Extractor) for latex, then smelt it into rubber for cables, belts and seals.

mods.name: Meteors
mods.desc: Meteor craters scar the overworld. Their cores hold meteorite, meteoric iron and rare star fragments - the key to meteoric steel tools and late-game tech.

mods.name: Waystones
mods.desc: Ancient waystones dot the land. Activate them to build a fast-travel network and teleport between any you have found - for a small cost in experience. You can craft your own, too.

mods.name: Fast Leaf Decay
mods.desc: Leaves left floating after you chop a tree fall within a few seconds.

mods.name: Towers
mods.desc: Lonely towers rise across the land: stone wizard towers with conical roofs, wooden forest watchtowers, sandstone desert towers and frozen ice spires, each with guards on the way up and loot at the top.

mods.name: Sky Islands
mods.desc: Floating islands drift high above the overworld - groves, sky ponds, quartz shrines and haunted ruins - with skystone, aether crystals and treasure for anyone who can get up there.

mods.name: Glowing Caves
mods.desc: The overworld's caves come alive with bioluminescent glowcaps, luminous moss and crystal growths - natural light for spelunkers, and ingredients for lamps and night-vision stew.

mods.name: Wild Flora
mods.desc: New trees - fiery maples, golden aspens and savanna baobabs - plus six wildflowers and blueberry and raspberry bushes to forage.

mods.name: The Depths
mods.desc: A vast underground dimension reached through a Depths Gate: fungal hollows lit by glowcaps, dripstone chasms and lush verdant grottos, an underground sea, new depthstone and the rare abyssal ore.

mods.name: The Skylands
mods.desc: A sunny dimension of floating islands drifting over the void, reached through a Skylands Gate: flowery meadows and forests in the sky, soft clouds that break your fall, skyshard ore, and the lair of the Sky Wyvern. Fall off and you tumble back to the overworld.

categories.title: Space
categories.intro: Rockets, space suits, the Moon and Mars.

mods.name: The Moon
mods.desc: A grey, airless world with one-third gravity, reached by a Tier 1 rocket. Bring a space suit (or an oxygen generator). Mine helium-3 crystals for advanced circuits and fusion, and collect moon dust and moon rock.

mods.name: Mars
mods.desc: The red planet, reached by a Tier 2 rocket: rust-red dunes and canyons under an orange sky, low gravity and no breathable air. Mars is the only source of titanium - the strongest metal in the pack - and martian dust.

mods.name: Rocketry
mods.desc: Build a rocket, place it on a launch pad, fill it with rocket fuel, climb in and press jump. Tier 1 rockets fly to the Moon, Tier 2 rockets to Mars - and either will bring you home again. Bring a space suit!

mods.name: Space Suit
mods.desc: Space has no air. Wear the full space suit to breathe on the Moon and Mars - its tank holds 30 minutes of oxygen - and build Oxygen Generators (powered by Forge Energy) to make an 8-block breathable bubble around your base and refill your suit.

mods.name: Stoneworks
mods.desc: Five new natural stones - marble, limestone, slate, gabbro and travertine - generating in large underground veins, each with polished, brick, chiseled, stair, slab and wall variants.

mods.name: Elevators
mods.desc: Elevator blocks in all 16 colours: jump to rise to the next elevator above, sneak to drop to the one below. Up to 24 blocks apart.

mods.name: Double Doors
mods.desc: Open one half of a double door and the other half opens with it.

mods.name: Ancient Ruins
mods.desc: Crumbling houses, broken arches, column circles and sunken cellars from a forgotten age dot the overworld, with ancient bricks to build with and treasure to dig up.

mods.name: Frontier Villagers
mods.desc: Four new village professions - the Engineer, Surveyor, Miner and Botanist - who trade tech parts, treasure maps, ores and exotic plants. Give a villager their workstation to recruit one.

mods.name: Glassworks
mods.desc: Better glass: blast-proof hardened glass, frameless clear glass, glowing glass, light-blocking dark glass and steel-framed glass, plus panes.

mods.name: Lamps & Lights
mods.desc: Colourful lighting: always-on lamps and redstone-controlled lamps in all sixteen dye colours, and compact cage lights for industrial builds.

mods.name: Frontier Decor
mods.desc: Building blocks for bases and homesteads: steel plating, rusted panels, hazard stripes, vents, grates, tiles, bricks, slate, steel beams and cargo crates, with stairs, slabs and walls.
